correctness.rationale: The edge set {xy} union {a_i b_i} is a matching of r+1 edges, so any vertex cover needs r+1 vertices. For landmarks X, the edge-distance signature families for xy, xa_i, a_i b_i, b_i y are respectively (0;all 1), (0;one 1 others 2), (1;one 0 others 2), (1;one 0 others 1); pairwise distinct for r>=2. The bipartition class X is a cover and Y is symmetric. A size-r+1 cover picks exactly one matching endpoint; if it picks x every edge yb_i forces b_i, so is X, else is Y. Independent Floyd-Warshall edge-distance and vertex-cover enumeration r=2..6 found exactly these two bases. r=1=C4 is correctly excluded.
